label: GB-dpa-2018 Section 158

obligations.text:
Fixed penalties for non-compliance with charges regulations
(1)
The Commission must produce and publish a document specifying the amount of the penalty for a failure to comply with regulations made under section 137.

(4)
The Commission—
(a)
may alter or replace the document, and
(b)
must publish any altered or replacement document.

(5)
Before publishing a document under this section (including any altered or replacement document), the Commission must consult—
(a)
the Secretary of State, and
(b)
such other persons as the Commission considers appropriate.

(6)
The Commission must arrange for a document published under this section (including any altered or replacement document) to be laid before Parliament.
